_comment: Tool-agnostic MCP server definitions, stowed to ~/.config/mcp/mcp.json.
This is the shared source: pi (via pi-mcp-adapter) reads this path directly,
as does anything else honoring the tool-agnostic location. Claude Code keeps
its own user-scope servers in ~/.claude.json and opencode its own in
~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc, because neither reads this file -- when you
add a server, add it in all three or drop it from the ones that do not need it.
Secrets never belong here: this repo is public. Remote servers authenticate
interactively (pi: /mcp panel; opencode: opencode mcp auth <name>).
